confirmed_root_causes.ISS-QRY-ALLOWLIST-KIND-01: src/entities/query/allowlist.zig loadAllowlist only reads entity_filterable_keys and assigns .kind=.jsonb_key. Missing: second query against entity_definitions.definition_json.fields (queried=true) for .kind=.typed_column. Also: tenant_id silently discarded (_ = tenant_id) — query lacks tenant scoping = cross-tenant leak.
confirmed_root_causes.ISS-QRY-RESPONSE-FIELD-NAME-01: src/entities/query/compiler.zig FilterFieldNotAllowlisted is bare error with no payload. Handler loses field name at error boundary.
confirmed_root_causes.ISS-QRY-CURSOR-PARSE-01: src/entities/query/cursor.zig uses ':' as both outer separator AND within fingerprint values. decodeCursor indexOf(':') finds first ':' inside fingerprint and truncates. For no-sort case default fingerprint 'record_id:asc' splits wrong.
confirmed_root_causes.ISS-QRY-AUDIT-SCHEMA-01: Test bug — tests/integration/query_qry01_04_test.zig lines 560 and 985 use ORDER BY created_at DESC but audit_entries column is timestamp. One-line fix in test.

task.description:
WF-03 Step 2 — Produce fix design artefact for 4 QRY bugs. Write to src/design/fix-ISS-QRY-bugs-20260818.md.

The design MUST specify (no implementation code — interfaces and data-flow only):

## Issue 1: ISS-QRY-ALLOWLIST-KIND-01 (src/entities/query/allowlist.zig)
- loadAllowlist must make TWO queries:
  a) SELECT from entity_filterable_keys WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND entity_key=$2 → AllowlistedField{.kind=.jsonb_key, ...}
  b) Read entity_definitions.definition_json.fields array for same tenant_id+entity_key; for each field where queried=true → AllowlistedField{.kind=.typed_column, .name=field.name}
- Merge: typed_column entries shadow same-name jsonb_key entries (design §AllowlistedField)
- tenant_id MUST be used as a positional parameter in both queries (not discarded)
- Specify the exact new function signature for loadAllowlist (should already accept tenant_id, entity_key)
- Specify the SQL for both queries (no inline strings allowed — design only specifies the SQL shape)

## Issue 2: ISS-QRY-RESPONSE-FIELD-NAME-01 (src/entities/query/compiler.zig + entity_query.zig route)
- FilterFieldNotAllowlisted must carry the rejected field name as a payload
- The error-to-HTTP-response path must include the field name in the JSON body: {"error": "filter_field_not_allowlisted", "field": "<name>"}
- Specify the tagged union or struct change to CompileError to carry the name

## Issue 3: ISS-QRY-CURSOR-PARSE-01 (src/entities/query/cursor.zig)
- The cursor must use a separator that cannot appear in fingerprint values
- Options: (a) use '|' as outer separator; (b) base64-encode the fingerprint portion; (c) use a different delimiter scheme
- Specify the new cursor format unambiguously so encode and decode are deterministic
- Must handle empty sort spec (no-sort default: fingerprint = "record_id:asc" by default)

## Issue 4: ISS-QRY-AUDIT-SCHEMA-01 (tests/integration/query_qry01_04_test.zig)
- One-line test fix: ORDER BY created_at → ORDER BY timestamp at lines ~560 and ~985
- Specify exact column name to use

The design file must not contain Zig implementation code. It should be precise enough for BACKEND-DEV to implement all 4 fixes without ambiguity.

result.summary: Fix design for 4 QRY bugs: allowlist tenant scoping + typed-column merge (#823), FilterFieldNotAllowlisted payload via out-param (#824), cursor fingerprint base64url-encode to eliminate colon ambiguity (#825), test ORDER BY column name (#826).
